headline: N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day exploited hours after PoC; Apache httpd HTTP/2 RCE patched; ScreenConnect breaches hit ~50 orgs

bullets.text: New: BleepingComputer reports an N-able zero-day dubbed "4EverAble2Shell" was exploited within hours of a public PoC; no CVE or fix is on the board yet. Separately, new N-central exploits work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access.
Apache HTTP Server patched a critical RCE, CVE-2026-119618, in its HTTP/2 handling. SecurityWeek says Anthropic and Google found it (4 outlets).

ConnectWise is investigating ScreenConnect breaches at nearly 50 organizations, alongside an exploited plugin flaw spreading malware across hundreds of PCs and SCKit malware targeting MSP support sessions (6 outlets).
The SignDrop Windows zero-day turns a CLFS security feature into SYSTEM access; no CVE or fix is on the board yet. Microsoft warns post-training supply chain attacks can hijack coding agents.

Still developing: a critical Red Hat Quay flaw exposes all private images in a registry; the Fireworks AI hack exposed Notion chat transcripts (7 outlets); Apify is rotating API tokens; Maersk says its incident hit a legacy system.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Outlook CVE-2026-124194 are due 11-24. SITCON 3, 1.1x the 90-day average.

actions: N-able / N-central: take consoles off the internet now, watch N-able for a 4EverAble2Shell fix, and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
Apache HTTP Server: patch every httpd instance for CVE-2026-119618 today; where you cannot, consider disabling HTTP/2 until patched.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for SCKit or other malware pushed through support sessions.
Windows: until a SignDrop fix ships, hunt for CLFS abuse and unexpected privilege escalation to SYSTEM.
Patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13; restrict Red Hat Quay registries to trusted networks pending a fix.
Rotate Apify tokens and any secrets shared in Notion AI chats; limit the credentials and repos coding agents can reach.
